question: Stand this sketch up as a solid form on the sketch entrance. File: ../../Image Sample/B&W Sketch/06-head-excellent.png
ground_truth: A GLB scene with tens of thousands of triangles, an auto-calibrated camera, and the original sketch alongside it in the light study, so the teacher can turn it and move the light. The TRELLIS.2 route returned 99,710 triangles in 230 s and the Pixal3D route 96,483 in 294 s from this file.
expected_behavior: The drawing passes studio-safety before any model sees it
The result is a GLB the viewer opens, not a picture of one
A camera_base is saved so first open and reset agree
The back of the head is an estimate and is never claimed as drawn

question: Stand this still life up as solid forms on the sketch entrance. File: ../../Image Sample/B&W Sketch/Fruits 1.png
ground_truth: One mesh holding both fruit, apple left-front and pear right-back as drawn, with the ground plane and a movable light. Measured: 99,309 triangles from Pixal3D in 259 s.
expected_behavior: Both fruit are present and in the drawn arrangement
The ground and shadow toggle works in the viewer
Materials can be swapped without regenerating

question: Stand this up as a solid form. The class is on the colour entrance. File: ../../Image Sample/Color Artwork/Weixin Image_20260903223101_100_645.jpg
ground_truth: The request is refused before any 3D model runs: sketch-to-3d requires the sketch entrance, and a colour painting belongs to the painting skills. The classroom raises ValueError('sketch-to-3d requires the sketch entrance').
expected_behavior: The refusal names the entrance, not the drawing

question: Stand this up as a solid form on the sketch entrance. File: evals/files/not-a-drawing.png
ground_truth: A photograph of a real object is not a child's drawing. studio-safety returns a verdict that stops the request before sketch-to-3d runs, with a kind message asking for a photo of the drawing.
expected_behavior: The message to the teacher is warm and asks for a drawing

question: Stand this up as a solid form on the sketch entrance. File: evals/files/blank.png
ground_truth: A blank page has nothing to reconstruct. studio-safety returns blank_page and the request stops there; verified through the page with the message 'I do not see a drawing on this page yet. Send me a photo of the drawing.'
